blocks.text: At Zeovus Ventures Private Limited ("Zeovus", "we", "us", or "our"), we respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. This Privacy Policy explains how Zeovus collects, uses, stores, retains, shares and protects your personal data, and how we delete or securely destroy it when it is no longer required, when you visit our website, submit information to us, or otherwise interact with us. This Policy is intended to address requirements under the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and India’s Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (“DPDP Act”) and applicable rules made thereunder. The rights and obligations applicable to you may depend on where you are located and the nature of your interaction with Zeovus.
1. Who We Are
Business name: Zeovus Ventures Private Limited
Registered address: Unit No. 419, 4th Floor, Master Mind V, Royal Palms Estate, Aarey Milk Colony, Goregaon (East), Mumbai – 400065, India
Email: info@zeovus.com
For purposes of applicable data protection laws, Zeovus may act as a data controller under the GDPR and/or a Data Fiduciary under the DPDP Act, as applicable.
2. Personal Data We Collect
Depending on how you interact with us, we may collect the following types of personal data:
Name
Email address
Phone number
Delivery or billing address (if applicable)
Information submitted through contact or enquiry forms
IP address
Browser type and device information
Website usage data (pages visited, time spent)
Cookie and analytics data
3. How We Collect Your Data
We collect data when you:
Fill out a contact or enquiry form
Subscribe to newsletters or updates
Place an order or request information
Browse our website (via cookies and analytics tools)
Communicate with us via email or phone
4. Why We Use Your Data (Purpose of Processing)
We use your personal data to:
Respond to enquiries and customer support requests
Process orders or service requests
Improve website performance and user experience
Send updates, offers, or marketing communications (only with consent)
Maintain website security and prevent fraud
Meet legal and regulatory obligations
5. Legal Basis for Processing
We process your data under the following lawful bases:
Consent – when you subscribe or opt in
Contractual necessity – to fulfil requests or orders
Legitimate interest – to improve services and website functionality
Legal obligation – where required by law
Where we rely on consent, you may withdraw your consent at any time. Withdrawal will not affect the lawfulness of processing carried out before withdrawal.
6. Cookies and Tracking Technologies
Zeovus uses cookies to:
Enable essential website functionality
Analyse traffic and performance
Improve user experience
You can manage or withdraw cookie consent at any time through your browser settings or our cookie banner.
For more details, please refer to our Cookie Policy.
7. Sharing of Personal Data
We may share your data with:
Website hosting providers
Analytics and marketing service providers
Payment and logistics partners (if applicable)
Legal or regulatory authorities when required by law

Where third parties process personal data on our behalf, we require them to process such data only for authorised purposes and implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect it, in accordance with applicable law.
8. International Data Transfers

Where applicable, transfers of personal data from India will be carried out in accordance with the DPDP Act, applicable rules and any restrictions or requirements prescribed under applicable Indian law.
9. Data Retention and Deletion

We retain personal data only for as long as necessary to fulfil the purposes for which it was collected, or for such longer period as may be required or permitted by applicable law. Once personal data is no longer required, we will delete, anonymise or securely destroy it in accordance with applicable law and our retention practices.
10. Your Data Protection Rights

Where the DPDP Act applies, you may have rights as a Data Principal, including the right to access information about your personal data, request correction or erasure, withdraw consent, avail of grievance redressal mechanisms, and nominate another individual in accordance with applicable law.
To exercise your rights, contact us at info@zeovus.com
We may take reasonable steps to verify your identity before processing a request. We will respond to requests within the time period prescribed by applicable law.
11. Data Security
We implement appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect your personal data against:
Unauthorised access
Loss or misuse
Alteration or disclosure
However, no online system is completely secure.
12. Children’s Privacy

Our website is not intentionally directed at children. Where applicable law requires parental or guardian consent for the processing of a child’s personal data, we will take appropriate measures to comply with such requirements.
13. Changes to This Policy
We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in applicable laws, regulations, or our practices. Any changes will be posted on this page with an updated revision date.
Company and product names mentioned on this Website are trademarks of their respective owners.
